job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Lead Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will be one of the technical leads for our DevOps Platforms organization. This group is responsible for DevOps Platforms including cloud infrastructure, physical data center orchestration, critical security services, and our Zoom for Government (ZfG) environment. You will be an uber tech lead working across a broad area, defining projects and guiding work across various teams. Your scope of work is wide and you will have the opportunity to improve our datacenter kubernetes infrastructure, our cloud infrastructure, our security posture, and our operation of ZfG environments. Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE and you will guide all of our teams toward SRE best practices (automation, monitoring, infrastructure as code, etc).

About the Team

The DevOps Platforms organization owns the full infrastructure stack: cloud infrastructure on AWS and OCI, physical data center orchestration, critical security services (identity, authentication, authorization), and Zoom's FedRAMP-rated federal environment, Zoom for Government (ZfG).

The team is currently working on one of the most technically interesting work in the org, hardening our security posture, and building the automation and reliability systems that underpin Zoom's global services. job.title: AI Scientist - Agentic Verticals
job.description:
AI Scientist - (AI Verticals)


What You Can Expect

In this role, you will tackle one of the most compelling challenges in production AI: enabling agents to continuously improve without compromising customer data privacy. You will own the development of synthetic data pipelines, advanced evaluation frameworks, and privacy-preserving feedback loops that drive measurable improvements in Zoom Virtual Agent performance, with your research shipping directly to production and serving real customers across Zoom’s growing portfolio of AI-powered products. As a part of the AI Verticals organization, you will operate with high autonomy in a fast-moving, research-to-production environment where innovations reach customers significantly faster than traditional research timelines.


This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence four (4) days per week at our San Jose, CA or Bellevue, WA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The AI Verticals team sits at the intersection of deep research and real-world production impact, advancing the intelligence and continuous improvement of Zoom’s AI agent products. Our work spans agent evaluation, model optimization, synthetic data generation, and self-improving systems, with direct influence on Zoom Virtual Agent and other products across the Zoom portfolio. The team operates a global development model with engineering partners across time zones, enabling research innovations to reach customers faster than traditional research organization timelines.


Responsibilities

  • Research and develop novel learning mechanisms that enable AI agents to continuously improve while adhering to customer data privacy and compliance requirements.
  • Develop synthetic data generation and simulation approaches that capture real production error patterns and customer behavior at scale, enabling model improvement through simulated scenarios.
  • Design advanced evaluation frameworks that go beyond traditional test sets and LLM-as-judge approaches, addressing how to assess and improve agent quality at scale without compromising customer data privacy.
  • Build scalable production feedback loops that leverage privacy-preserving signals and simulated scenarios to drive continuous improvements in agent performance.
  • Analyze customer needs and business outcomes, including resolution rate, escalation patterns, and conversation quality, to guide research priorities and deliver measurable improvements in agent performance.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy research innovations into production systems, balancing scientific rigor with practical engineering constraints.
  • Contribute to the research community by publishing findings on self-improving agents, synthetic data generation, and privacy-preserving learning techniques.

What We’re Looking For

  • Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with a research focus on autonomous agents, reinforcement learning, self-supervised learning, or LLM-based systems, or equivalent practical experience in these areas.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with large language models (LLMs) applied to agent systems or real-world production scenarios.
  • Strong foundation in machine learning and reinforcement learning, with demonstrated experience in self-improving systems, continual learning, or agents that learn from limited feedback.
  • Creative approach to evaluation challenges, with the ability to develop novel metrics and frameworks for agent quality in privacy-constrained environments, beyond standard test sets and LLM-as-judge methods.
  • Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or Java, with hands-on experience in AI frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate research innovations into production systems at scale, balancing scientific rigor with practical engineering timelines.
  • Intellectual curiosity, bias for action, and growth mindset, with the drive to take ownership of ambiguous, open-ended problems and deliver measurable customer impact.

What You Can Expect

As a Senior Design Producer at Zoom, you'll be the driving force behind great design—bringing exceptional operational discipline and strategic thinking to keep projects moving forward. You'll partner with designers, researchers, product managers, and engineers to turn bold ideas into polished experiences used by millions of people every day. You'll bring structure to creative work, clarity to complex timelines, and momentum to cross-functional initiatives, so our designers can do their best work and our customers feel the difference.


You can expect a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your contributions directly shape how design is delivered across Zoom's platform. Reporting to the Head of Design, this role will lead and define the overall UX project management charter across all of Zoom Workplace.


About the Team

The UX Design team at Zoom crafts the experiences behind Zoom Workplace, our AI-powered collaboration platform that integrates communication, productivity, and engagement into a single, seamless product used by millions of people worldwide. We are a global team of designers, researchers, and design technologists spanning multiple product areas, united by a shared commitment to simplicity, craft, and genuine user delight. We work in close partnership with Product and Engineering to continuously raise the bar on how people connect and collaborate.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, schedule, and drive end-to-end delivery of UX projects, defining milestones, deliverables, and timelines with precision
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Design, Product Management, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to keep work aligned and unblocked
  • Manage project scope, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and trade-offs and escalating issues before they impact delivery
  • Allocate and balance design resources across concurrent initiatives and shifting priorities to maximize team output
  • Establish and continuously improve design operations processes spanning research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and design reviews
  • Communicate project status, decisions, and changes clearly to leadership and partner teams
  • Coordinate across global and distributed design teams, navigating time zone complexity to maintain delivery momentum
  • Track design quality and delivery metrics, applying insights to improve how the team plans, executes, and ships
  • Manage design tooling and vendor relationships in partnership with design leadership

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of UX project management experience, with a strong understanding of the full design process from research through delivery

The Audio Video team is Zoom's technical foundation for real-time communication, owning the full media pipeline from device capture through processing, encoding, transmission, decoding, and rendering. The team delivers the audio and video experience across Zoom Workplace's native client, web-based client, and Video SDK, enabling developers and enterprise customers to build reliable, high-quality communication tools.   • Solid, production-proven WebRTC development experience, including real-world debugging, protocol-level issue resolution, and cross-browser compatibility work.
